steps.observed: UTC8的10月24日只D/B/C，退款2700分；kind+账号手机+车牌+DONE组合只D，chips正确。

steps.name: 分页、详情和返回
steps.observed: 20条与15条/页，翻页后PAGE-06详情金额10.06正确；重置回第1页；空查询0条；从日志返回订单保留PAGE过滤且旧审计按钮不可见。

steps.name: 实际CSV导出
steps.observed: 日期匹配3条、无筛选第2页导出34条、PAGE过滤第2页导出27条；非当前页15条或全库34条。未提交草稿不生效；=CMD(A1)加单引号保护。

steps.name: 失败和重试
steps.observed: 实际fail-next造成query503，页面明确持久化不可用，导出禁用、PAGE草稿保留；实际点重试恢复27条。

steps.name: 取消、退款和报表
steps.observed: C是WAIT_CONTINUE待乘客续叫而非终结；退款3轮同额同刻各900分共2700不去重；日统计3单1完1取消1活跃，模拟实付20/退款27元；详情可读。

steps.name: 司机、乘客和模拟账务
steps.observed: 三个列表均加载真实query并实际查询/打开对应详情；缺登记日期明确禁用且说明，不伪造。提现审核变更本轮未执行。

steps.name: 只读角色和边界
steps.observed: VIEWER导出和调价按钮disabled；自己的HTTP会话直接export/action403、无session401、driver路径404；结束所有本地会话logout并重置viewport。

findings.observed: Payment projection id WITHDRAWAL:D1:W1 differs from real withdrawalId W1; both approve/reject handlers still pass p.id.
findings.proof: Non-author static source confirms dispatch uses id:p.id; backend query contract and actual W2 detail show prefixed projection id. Coordinator first reported failure. Reviewer did not click monetary mutation or independently induce404.
findings.recommendation: Use withdrawalId||id only for withdrawal action payload, retain projection id for row lookup. Fix author then independent delta with explicit local fixture mutation if authorized.

findings.observed: OC1 list labels associated account as D, but actual account is P1 and order is D; detail already correct.
findings.recommendation: Display accountId/factual account label in list; preserve ownerId for support reply payload.
